items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Cripple Slim used to go down there with Sidney (they were buddies)... Sidney stayed close to his Daddy... Sidney was more gutbucket. He ended up with Charlie Johnson... Sidney said he used to see...

ctx.x: They took you all through that, huh.

Yeah. And then he said, "Well, Mother wanted me to have an education. You was more devoted to Papa than I was. You was Mama's boy and I was Papa's boy." "But you didn't treat us right." You know, just a... They told all their business. So the mother used to... Wilbur was her first-born, I guess. I don't know, I think they have a sister, a sister in Baltimore. Cripple Slim used to go down there with Sidney (they were buddies), and spend a couple of weeks in the summer. Wilbur...
